references.text: Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh asked to receive land east of the Jordan, which is why they received their inheritance there.
Moses gave the land of Sihon and Og to the children of Gad, the children of Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh; this is the specific allocation referred to.
Moses describes how he gave the land east of the Jordan to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Confirms that this land was given as an inheritance to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Joshua reminds the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh that they received their inheritance east of the Jordan.
Describes the inheritance that the Reubenites and the Gadites received on the east side of the Jordan.
Joshua sends the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh home to their allotted inheritance east of the Jordan.
